notes.title: ⚜️Sword & Shield Simulator playtest START date and much, much more... ⚜️
notes.content:
Hello Folks,
the Sword & Shield Simulator playtests will begin on 22.05.2024 and will last 7 days

During the tests we would like to 

 show you, our community the test version that we have been working on so far, among other things
 collect feedback and possible proposals for improvements and changes
 
We are already looking forward to it

We have an extra surprise, right now we are launching the Steam Sword & Shield Prologue website ADD TO WISHLIST
Release schedule for the compilation:

 22.05.2024 Playtest Build
 date depends on feedback - demo version
 q4/q1 2024 compilation of Prologue
 q1 2025 Full game

 Prologue Version


What's more in the news? We are proud that our team has joined the great company Code Horizon
which is the developer of the best-selling Gold Mining Simulator (old Gold Rush: The Game).

 Link to our new Discord - https://discord.gg/DAcuxe8gfG
